svg.text: Body over the skeleton · small scales covered by rows of keeled armor plates, side spikes and a bony tail club · about 7 m long
Faint grey = skeleton inside the body
MOUTH OPEN · the living animal's jaws and teeth
rows of very small leaf-shaped teeth
bony armor tiles fused to the skull
wide head, wide beak; horns at each corner
very small for the animal's size
short, hoof-like; the front legs carried most
of the weight (finger count is partly fiction)
E · LOWER LEG AND FOOT, SIDE
short, thick leg on a heel pad;
3 hoofed toes on a wide pad
ANKYLOSAURUS MAGNIVENTRIS · MOUTH, TEETH, HAND AND FOOT
